_note: Selectable LLM profiles (src/web_api/llm_profiles.py). A request without a profile, or with auto, behaves as before. The browser sends only an id; the model, URL and key are chosen here. external=true means the request leaves the company network. blocked_zones lists zone ids (hub = the home page guide). Zones kept off the external models by default hold CSIT reports, vendor files, internal wiki/Jira pages and personnel/finance documents; change this list only with the data owner's agreement.
